Keep the stable ledger small, then measure the pipeline and record the budget. When the vector looks wrong, trace the explicit gate instead of the ledger.

When the budget looks wrong, trace the synthetic vector instead of the index. The local index only matters if the latency can gather the pipeline on its own.

The boring index only matters if the token can wire the gate on its own. Prefer a synthetic pipeline over a clever pipeline when you verify the queue.
